summary_zh: 本页为绘本《恐龙骨头会说话》的扉页，展示了书名、作者信息及一只剑龙的骨骼线稿图，下方标注了出版社信息。

page_text_ocr_zh:
阿宝哥带小朋友们去看恐龙，到了博物馆，大家只看到恐龙的骨头，没看到恐龙。恐龙在哪里呢？原来，恐龙就藏在恐龙的骨头里。

怎么没看到恐龙，只看到恐龙的骨头？

嘘！博物馆里不能大声讲话。

请小朋友打开两边的翻页，把恐龙变出来！

腕龙

梁龙

暴龙

三角龙
page_text_en:
Abo Brother took the children to see dinosaurs. When they arrived at the museum, everyone only saw dinosaur bones, not the dinosaurs themselves. Where are the dinosaurs? Originally, the dinosaurs are hidden inside the dinosaur bones.

How come we can't see the dinosaurs, only their bones?

Shh! We can't talk loudly in the museum.

Please, children, open the flaps on both sides to bring the dinosaurs to life!

Brachiosaurus

Diplodocus

Tyrannosaurus

Triceratops
summary_zh: 阿宝哥带孩子们参观博物馆，看到各种恐龙骨架，孩子们对只看到骨头而看不到活恐龙感到疑惑，一个粉色小精灵引导他们通过翻页互动来‘变出’恐龙。

page_text_ocr_zh:
恐龙躲在恐龙骨头里
恐龙的骨头很重要，科学家们仔细研究恐龙的骨头，发现了恐龙的许多秘密。梁龙和腕龙的骨头很大，科学家们把它们的骨头排列起来，发现梁龙和腕龙都是又长又高的巨龙。
我是暴龙，大家又叫我“霸王龙”！
我是小梁龙，长大后会变成巨龙哦！
page_text_en:
Dinosaurs Hide in Dinosaur Bones
Dinosaur bones are very important. Scientists carefully study dinosaur bones and discover many secrets about dinosaurs. The bones of Brachiosaurus and Diplodocus are very large. When scientists arrange their bones, they find that Brachiosaurus and Diplodocus are both long and tall giants.
I am Tyrannosaurus, everyone also calls me 'Tyrannosaurus Rex'!
I am little Brachiosaurus, I will grow up to become a giant dinosaur!
summary_zh: 本页通过图文结合的方式，介绍了科学家通过研究恐龙骨头来还原恐龙形态，并展示了暴龙和小梁龙的对话，说明恐龙的体型特征。

page_text_ocr_zh:
腕龙
▲ 腕龙的脖子、尾巴和腿部的骨头都比梁龙大，科学家们
由此推测，腕龙比梁龙更高大。
▼ 梁龙的头骨很小，脖子和尾巴的骨头排列起来却很长，
是现在所能找到的恐龙骨头中，身体最长的恐龙之一，
大约是八头成年非洲象排起来的长度。
梁龙
▼ 梁龙的尾巴很长，可以像鞭子一样甩动，攻击敌人，所
以连肉食恐龙也不敢欺负它。
▶ 腕龙的前腿比后腿长，它
可以像长颈鹿一样，抬高
脖子吃树上的叶子。而梁
龙的脖子却没法像腕龙那
样抬高。
三角龙
page_text_en:
Brachiosaurus
▲ The bones of Brachiosaurus's neck, tail, and legs are all larger than those of Diplodocus. Scientists therefore infer that Brachiosaurus is taller and larger than Diplodocus.
▼ Diplodocus has a small skull, but its neck and tail bones, when arranged, are very long. It is one of the longest dinosaurs whose bones have been found so far, roughly the length of eight adult African elephants lined up.
Diplodocus
▼ Diplodocus has a very long tail, which it can whip like a lash to attack enemies, so even carnivorous dinosaurs dare not bully it.
▶ Brachiosaurus has front legs longer than its hind legs. It can lift its neck like a giraffe to eat leaves from trees. However, Diplodocus cannot lift its neck as high as Brachiosaurus.
Triceratops
summary_zh: 本页通过图文结合的方式，介绍了腕龙和梁龙的骨骼特征及其生活习性，如腕龙因前肢较长能高抬脖子吃树叶，梁龙则因身体极长且尾巴可作武器而具有防御能力，同时展示了三角龙的形象。

page_text_ocr_zh:
牙齿，说出恐龙
暴龙有尖尖的牙齿，这表明
它是吃肉的恐龙，因为只有尖尖
的牙齿才能把肉咬下来。
救命啊！
▲ 暴龙嘴巴撕咬的力量很大，
它能一口咬断其他恐龙的骨头，再把肉咬下来，不用咀嚼，直接吞进肚子里。
吃的食物
三角龙的牙齿
又大又平，可以用
来磨碎树叶。
▶ 三角龙的嘴前端尖尖的，
像鸟嘴，嘴里还有两排可
以磨碎植物的牙齿。
牙齿
page_text_en:
Teeth, telling the story of dinosaurs
Tyrannosaurus has sharp, pointed teeth, which shows
it is a meat-eating dinosaur, because only sharp
pointed teeth can bite into meat.
Help! (from the child)
▲ The Tyrannosaurus's jaw has great biting power;
it can bite through the bones of other dinosaurs, then bite off the meat, without chewing, swallowing it directly.
Food
Triceratops has large, flat teeth,
which can be used
to grind leaves.
▶ The front of the Triceratops's mouth is pointed,
like a bird's beak, and inside there are two rows of teeth
that can grind plant matter.
Teeth
summary_zh: 本页通过对比暴龙和三角龙的牙齿特征，解释了它们的食性：暴龙的尖牙用于撕咬肉类，而三角龙的平牙用于磨碎植物，同时展示了它们的骨骼和生活场景。

page_text_ocr_zh:
头骨，说出防卫的技巧
三角龙的头骨很大，像个大头盔一样，能保护
脆弱的脖子免受攻击。它的头上还有三只角，可以
把肉食恐龙刺伤，以保护自己。
我头上有尖角，
才不怕你！
敌人来了，
大家快逃！
副栉（zhì）龙的头骨里是空的，所以
它能让发出的声音变得很大。当它们
遇到危险时，会发出很大的叫声，互
相警告。
那就比一比吧！
我的头很硬，
才不怕你！
厚头龙的头骨又厚又硬，它可以用
厚厚的头骨撞击对方，赶走其他厚
头龙或者敌人。
page_text_en:
Skull, Revealing Defense Techniques
The Triceratops's skull is large, like a big helmet, protecting its vulnerable neck from attacks. It also has three horns on its head, which can stab carnivorous dinosaurs to defend itself.
I have sharp horns on my head,
so I'm not afraid of you!
Enemies are coming,
everyone, run away!
The Parasaurolophus's skull is hollow, so
it can make its sounds very loud. When they
encounter danger, they make loud calls to
warn each other.
Let's have a competition!
My head is very hard,
so I'm not afraid of you!
The Pachycephalosaurus's skull is thick and hard. It can use
its thick skull to ram opponents, driving away other Pachycephalosaurus or enemies.
summary_zh: 本页通过三角龙、副栉龙和厚头龙的例子，介绍了不同恐龙如何利用其独特的头骨结构进行防御，如三角龙用角刺敌、副栉龙用空心头骨发声警告、厚头龙用厚头骨撞击对手。

page_text_ocr_zh:
奇怪的骨头里有更多秘密
剑龙的骨板可以吸热和散热，让它的身体保持温暖或凉爽，也可以变色，用来求偶或者吓退敌人，功能非常多。它尾巴上的骨刺可以用来攻击敌人，和包头龙的骨锤一样厉害。

←科学家们发现，剑龙的骨板里有很多血管，可以帮助吸热或散热，调节体温。

前面那只公剑龙的骨板变色了，好帅哦！

▼包头龙的身体上布满尖刺，可以保护自己，尾巴上还有骨锤，可以攻击敌人。

被剑龙的骨刺打中了，好痛！

看我骨锤的厉害！
page_text_en:
More Secrets in Strange Bones
The plates on a Stegosaurus can absorb and release heat, keeping its body warm or cool. They can also change color, used for attracting mates or scaring off enemies—very versatile. The spikes on its tail can be used to attack enemies, just as powerful as the Ankylosaurus's club.

← Scientists discovered that the plates of a Stegosaurus contain many blood vessels, helping to absorb or release heat and regulate body temperature.

The plates on that male Stegosaurus in front have changed color—so cool!

▼ The Ankylosaurus's body is covered in spikes for protection, and it has a bone club on its tail to attack enemies.

I've been hit by the Stegosaurus's spikes—ouch!

Look at the power of my bone club!
summary_zh: 本页介绍了剑龙骨板的多种功能，如调节体温、变色求偶或吓退敌人，以及其尾部骨刺的攻击作用，并对比了包头龙的防御结构，通过对话展示了恐龙间的互动场景。

page_text_ocr_zh:
恐龙的秘密都藏在骨头里
科学家们研究恐龙骨头，能知道以前恐龙的生活是什么样的，也许有一天，科学家们真的能让恐龙复活。到那时，我们就能知道该怎么照顾恐龙，怎么和它们一起生活了！

▶ 腕龙会伸长脖子吃树叶，像现代的长颈鹿。

▽ 暴龙会追捕猎物，像现代的猎豹。

▲ 三角龙会把敌人团团围住，进行抵抗。
page_text_en:
The secrets of dinosaurs are hidden in their bones.
Scientists study dinosaur bones to learn what their lives were like. Maybe one day, scientists will really be able to bring dinosaurs back to life. Then, we'll know how to take care of them and how to live with them!

▶ Brachiosaurus stretches its neck to eat leaves, just like modern giraffes.

▽ Tyrannosaurus chases prey, just like modern cheetahs.

▲ Triceratops surrounds enemies and fights back.
summary_zh: 本页通过图文结合的方式，介绍了科学家通过研究恐龙骨头来了解恐龙生活，并通过对比腕龙、暴龙和三角龙的特征，说明了它们的习性和防御方式。
本页通过插图展示了三角龙和副栉龙的互动场景，上方为两只三角龙在山地环境中，下方为一只副栉龙正对着另一只恐龙的头骨发出声音，暗示其头冠可能用于发声或交流。
